title: feat(security, create-objectstack): an AI-built app with its own capabilities and no connector plugins installs as an unmanaged copy
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-warren"} -->
_Requested by **Warren** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01U5RdnAAmkSQmZbqh6FtqZ8?thread=cmsg_01U5RdnAAmkSQmZbqh6FtqZ8VH1Lpmpnn1qKtP3Cjyaewt)_

Part of #35157 (item 1 is ruled option A, record 6999763503, maintainer: 「同意」; the `everyone`-anchor bound is ruled 「接受现有边界」, record 7000639892. The ADR-0126 amendment note stays a separate governed PR after this merges).

Clause-②: yes (widening)
Metadata-protocol: added
Skills-docs: none — no skill teaches capability as code-only, the scaffold's plugin list, or unmanaged install; the docs pages are updated here (`content/docs/permissions/capabilities.mdx`, `content/docs/deployment/install-modes.mdx`, `content/docs/getting-started/your-first-project.mdx`, `content/docs/automation/connectors.mdx`)

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：AI 生成的应用现在能以“非托管副本”安装（市场试用）。应用自带的能力项（capability）会随副本一起复制，并改成副本的命名空间；引用它的权限集和动作同步改名。新建项目的脚手架不再默认列出三个连接器插件。
- 为什么改：之前能力项只能写在代码里，而脚手架默认带插件。两者都让 AI 生成的应用只能托管安装，所以场景卡（请假余额、采购到收货、资产生命周期）没法做成市场试用。
- 风险与回滚：能力项变成可在运行时保存，属于权限边界的变化。平台能力名（如 manage_users）和其它包已占用的名字在保存时一律拒绝，权限闸仍按名字匹配。它重新开放了 ADR-0126 第 9 节未授权的 code-only 类型，维护者已裁 A（记录 6999763503，「同意」）。全员锚点的边界按记录 7000639892（「接受现有边界」）：只有绑定到包（`_packageId`）的声明被豁免，没有包的保存不豁免，正文里写的 `packageId` 也不算。回滚：回退本 PR 的 capability 部分即可。
- 先看：`packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol-save-door-refusals.ts`（平台名与占用名的拒绝）、`packages/metadata-protocol/src/package-namespace-rename.ts`（副本改名与引用改写）、`packages/spec/src/kernel/metadata-plugin.zod.ts`（类型登记从 code-only 改为可运行时创建）
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/objectql exec vitest run src/protocol-unmanaged-import-rename-battery.test.ts`，预期 12 个用例全过。其中三个演示副本动作只对副本权限集持有者放行，对只持有源权限集的人拒绝。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地（ADR-0126 的修订说明在合并后另开受管面 PR）。

## What changes

**Item 1: a package-declared capability is copied by an unmanaged install (option A, ruled in record 6999763503).**

- `packages/spec/src/kernel/metadata-plugin.zod.ts`: the `capability` registry entry is `allowRuntimeCreate: true`. Overlays stay closed (`supportsOverlay: false`, `allowEnvironmentOverlay: false`). The body is still judged by `CapabilityDeclarationSchema`.
- `packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol-save-door-refusals.ts` and `protocol-save.ts`: the save door refuses two capability names with `422 NAMESPACE_CONFLICT`:
  - a platform capability (`PLATFORM_CAPABILITIES`). The registry answers its bare slot first, so an environment item under that name would shadow the platform's definition;
  - a name an installed package's capability holds (one holder per name, as for permission sets and positions). The promote and restore doors already call the same refusal.
- `packages/objectql/src/security-catalog-namespace.ts`: `ENVIRONMENT_HELD_SECURITY_CATALOG_TYPES` adds `capability`, so a package shipping a capability name the environment authored refuses the boot, as positions and permission sets do.
- `packages/metadata-protocol/src/package-namespace-rename.ts`: when the copy takes a new namespace, a capability named `<ns>.x` or `<ns>_x` is renamed into it. `systemPermissions` (list or per-operation map) and `requiredPermissions` are rewritten with it. An unprefixed capability keeps its name. A renamed name another package's capability holds refuses the install, naming both.

**Item 2: the scaffold stops writing connector plugins (the install contract is unchanged).**

- `packages/create-objectstack/src/templates/blank/*`: `objectstack.config.ts` lists no `plugins:`, and `package.json` drops the three connector packages. The README and the config comment show how to add a provider when an app declares a connector.

**Docs.** The capability and install-mode pages describe environment-authored capabilities, the two refused names, the rename in an unmanaged copy and the new refusal row. The getting-started and connectors pages match the scaffold.

## Tests

- `packages/objectql/src/protocol-unmanaged-import-rename-battery.test.ts`: an app with a capability-gated action installs unmanaged under a new namespace. The rows are renamed. The security catalog resolves the copy's capability with `scope: 'org'`. The copied action passes a holder of the copy's set and refuses a non-holder and a holder of only the source's set.
- `packages/spec/src/stack-unmanaged-install-mode.test.ts`: an app that gates an action on its own capability, with the scaffold's default (no) plugins, validates with `installModes: ['unmanaged']`.
- `packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol.capability-write-door.test.ts`: a garbage body gets `422`. Valid saves pass, including the plural spelling. `manage_users` gets `NAMESPACE_CONFLICT`, and so does a package-held name. A permission-catalog holder of the same spelling does not block (control). A re-save of the environment's own item passes. `/meta/types` reports `allowRuntimeCreate: true`.
- `packages/metadata-protocol/src/package-namespace-rename.test.ts`: five rename cases (dot and underscore prefixes, unprefixed kept, both reference keys, collision refusal).
- `packages/objectql/src/protocol-boot-hydration-scoped.test.ts`: the cold-boot environment-holder refusal runs for `capability` beside `permission` and `position`.
- The code-only lists in `protocol.code-only-types`, `protocol.recovery-doors-emit-mutation` and `protocol.packaged-base-refusal` drop `capability`.
- `packages/plugins/plugin-security/src/builtin-capabilities.test.ts`: an environment-saved capability body carrying `packageId` (no row binding) excuses nothing at the `everyone` anchor, on the registry list and on the metadata-service fallback (`packageId` or `package`).

## Acceptance notes

- ADR-0126 §9 lists "reopening any code-only type (field, job, api, capability, agent)" as not chartered. The maintainer ruled A (record 6999763503: 「同意」), so the ADR amendment note ships as a separate governed PR after this one merges.
- The `everyone`-anchor bound stands as ruled in record 7000639892, option 「接受现有边界」: 「平台权限和别的应用已声明的权限点照旧一律挡住；只有没人声明过的名字，管理员能在可编辑的应用里声明一次。本次只把说明写准。」 The anchor excuses a declaration bound to a package (`_packageId`, the row's binding as the server states it) and nothing else: a capability saved with no package excuses nothing, whatever package its own `packageId` names (contract review 7005578464, S5). No stricter refusal is built; refusing a body whose `packageId` disagrees with its row's binding is outside this card.
- cloud#4856 (the double namespace prefix) is related and not taken here, because the cloud lane is paused.

## Verification

- `@objectstack/objectql`: `protocol-unmanaged-import-rename-battery` 12/12, `protocol-boot-hydration-scoped` 21/21; full suite running.
- `@objectstack/spec`: `stack-unmanaged-install-mode`, `capability-metadata-kind`, `metadata-create-seeds`, `metadata-type-field-registration` pass; full suite running.
- `create-objectstack`: 379 passed.
- `@objectstack/lint`: `validate-security-posture.runtime-surface`, `runtime-gate.inert-type-writes`, 72 passed. `@objectstack/metadata-core` `meta-write-capability` 15 passed. `plugin-security` `access-upgrade-report` passed.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec build` then `check:generated`: 13 of 14 artifacts current, no diff to commit. `check:test-typecheck` crashed with no diagnostics under memory pressure from the parallel test run; re-run pending.
- `check:doc-authoring`, `check:doc-anchors`, `check:docs-single-h1`, `check:docs-spec-enumerations`, `check:changeset-fixed`, `check:docs-audit-scope`, `check:docs-transcript-drift`: pass.

</details>

- `plugin-security` full suite: 279 files, 6992 passed, 45 skipped (`VERDICT command-exit 0`). Touched suites alone: `builtin-capabilities`, `suggested-audience-bindings`, `builtin-capabilities.boot`, 87 passed.
- Ablation of the S5 reading (`_packageId ?? packageId ?? package`, put back through `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`, anchor 1 to 0, blob 18a0c1bc to 68552ad7): `builtin-capabilities.test.ts` 2 failed, 10 passed, the two new pins red. Restored: blob equals HEAD, `git diff HEAD` empty; with the fix 12 passed.
- `metadata-protocol` `package-namespace-rename.test.ts` 18 passed (comments only in that file). `typecheck` of `plugin-security` (with `check:test-typecheck`) and `metadata-protocol`: exit 0.
- Local gate subset, all exit 0: `check:nul-bytes`, `check:doc-authoring`, `check:doc-anchors`, `check:docs-spec-enumerations`, `check:docs-transcript-drift`, `check:issue-citations`, `check:durability-log-level`, `check:cross-package-test-inputs`, `check:test-source-alias`, `check:doc-security-posture`, `check:doc-formula-expressions`, `check-affected-docs`, `check-docs-section-name`, `check:closed-ceremony-text`, `check:role-word`. The other 71 derived families are CI's (declared narrowing).

</details>
